'''Pac''' was an alias that was used by a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] who served as a [[Private/Legends|private]] in the [[Cularin Militia]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Following the discovery of a document written by the [[Scout/Legends|explorer]] [[Reidi Artom]], Pac and two Militia privates under the alias' [[Grunt]] and [[Mack (alias)|Mack]] made their way to the offices of [[Cularin Central Broadcasting]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] and demanded to be interviewed by the [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]] [[Yara Grugara]]. Grugara agreed to their proposition and during the interview, Pac and his compatriots explained that they were opposed to the anti-war views that Artom expressed in the recently discovered document.
